title: feat(ui): the hosted unmanaged install dialog shows and edits its target namespace
body:
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBGU8m9WENyvoKLyxe2kUbYo)_ Fixes #32040 Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：托管环境里以「非托管副本」安装应用时，安装对话框多了一个「目标命名空间」输入框，预填控制面给的默认值（经 #32182 的同源路由 `GET /api/v1/cloud-connection/install-namespace` 读取），可以修改，安装时作为 `target_namespace` 发出；托管安装不画输入框、不发这个键。 - 为什么改：#31482 之后服务端已能按命名空间复制，只差界面；之前对话框既不显示也不能改命名空间，冲突时也不能换名重试。 - 风险与回滚：只动界面和 11 种语言的 `marketplace` 懒加载文案，不动服务端和 `packages/spec`；读不到默认值（`503`/`502`）时输入框留空，手填仍可安装，空着则不发键、沿用控制面默认。回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - 先看：`MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` 的 `namespaceFieldShown` / `doInstall` 的 catch 分支，`marketplaceApi.ts` 的 `getInstallNamespace`，新文件 `targetNamespaceRefusal.ts`（三种拒绝怎么分）。 - 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.installMode-12288.test.tsx`，预期 46 条全绿；截图在项目文件夹 `ui-orders/32040-shots/`。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。⚠️ 默认值读的是 `data.namespace`，这个键名取自路由测试的转发样例，云端 PR #4206 本会话读不到，请席位核一下。 ## What changes - **The namespace read.** `marketplaceApi.getInstallNamespace(packageId)` calls `GET /api/v1/cloud-connection/install-namespace?package_id=…` with the same `withEnvAuth` + `credentials: 'include'` that `installPackage` uses, and returns the trimmed string at `data.namespace`, else `null`. `null` covers `503 CLOUD_UNCONFIGURED`, `502 EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR`, any other refusal, a network failure and a non-string value: the field is empty, never a guessed name. - **The install body.** `installPackage` takes an optional `targetNamespace` and sends it as `target_namespace` on the hosted same-origin route only, only beside `installMode: 'unmanaged'`, trimmed, never blank. A managed install never carries the key, since the route refuses it there. - **The dialog.** For an unmanaged hosted install (never an update), the dialog draws a "Target namespace" field: a skeleton while the read is in flight (Install waits), then an editable input pre-filled with the default, or empty with a "no default could be read" hint. `data-state` on `install-target-namespace` is `loading`, `ready` or `refused`. - **Refusals**, sorted by `targetNamespaceRefusal.ts` from the error's `code` (read with `errorCodeIs`) and `details` (which `installPackage` already carries on its thrown error): - `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with `details.namespace`: the dialog stays open, the field says the name is taken (localized, naming it), focus returns to the field, and Install is enabled for another name. - `400 INVALID_REQUEST` with `details.targetNamespace`: the server's sentence is shown beside the field. - `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with `details.targetPackageId` (a second unmanaged copy): shown as a plain refusal in the dialog's result box, with no re-ask, since no namespace clears it (card item 3, stated not fixed). - **Strings.** Five keys under `marketplace.install.targetNamespace.*` in all 11 files of the `marketplace` lazy namespace (`zh-Hant` generated by `gen:zh-hant`). ⛔ Nothing in `src/locales/en.ts`. The German `taken` string adds one „…“ pair, so `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` moves its two pins by one, with a dated line in each comment as earlier additions did. - **Changeset** `.changeset/32040-hosted-install-target-namespace.md`: `@object-ui/i18n` patch. `@object-ui/app-shell` is private and gets no row. `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: `@object-ui/i18n` gains five strings. `marketplaceApi`'s exported surface does widen (the new `getInstallNamespace` export and the optional `targetNamespace` input), but it lives in the private `@object-ui/app-shell`, so nothing it adds publishes. ## Why #31482 lets the control plane copy a package under a chosen namespace, and #32182 (#32083) added the same-origin read of its default. The dialog was the missing piece: it sent no namespace and drew no field. ## Verification - `MarketplacePackagePage.installMode-12288.test.tsx`: 46 / 46, 12 of them new (two new describes in the existing harness; `marketplaceApi` is not mocked, one stubbed `fetch` answers by path): default shown and sent, edited value sent, `503` / `502` empty field still installs a typed name, empty field sends no key, ownership `409` re-asks and installs a new name, `400` sentence beside the field, `targetPackageId` `409` gives no re-ask, managed install shows no field, reads no default and sends no key, plus `installPackage` / `getInstallNamespace` unit pins. - **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, delete `...withNamespace,` from the hosted body): 6 tests go red (default sent, edited sent, both `503`/`502` typed-name cases, the re-ask case, the unit pin). Restored; `git diff HEAD` empty. - `vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace packages/app-shell/src/__tests__ packages/i18n`: 183 files, all green after the German pin move (that suite holds the ADR-0060 `product-neutral-renderer.ratchet` test). - `type-check` of `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`: clean. ESLint on the changed files: 0 errors. `node scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` (ui): clean. - Full `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'`: 119 / 119. - Derived gates: every line of `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, plus `pnpm --dir ui run check:eager-closure`, `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols`; results in the `--ran` reading below. - **Browser.** A hosted environment is not bootable in this container (no control plane). Shot against a real CRM dev boot and the console on Vite, with Playwright mocking the hosted routes (`runtime/config` patched to a cloud base with `installLocal: false`, the catalog, manifest, `install-namespace` and `install` answers). Seven dialog states in the project folder `ui-orders/32040-shots/`: loading, default shown, no default (`503`), name taken (`409`), malformed (`400`), second copy (`409 targetPackageId`), managed (no field).
dispatch-gates --ran: 39 derived, 39 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED; every exit 0 `check:eager-closure` and `check:spec-symbols` (ui) ran beside the 39 and exited 0; `check-sdui-manifest` is one of the 39. Gate scripts ran on a shared box.
## Known limits - The namespace key inside `data` is read as `namespace`, taken from the relay pin in `cloud-connection-plugin.test.ts`, which #32182's own body calls an illustrative fixture. Cloud PR #4206 is not readable from this session. If the control plane sends another key, the field is simply empty (a typed name still installs); it never sends a wrong value. - A second unmanaged copy of the same package is still refused, as the card says (item 3). ## Human Minimum - [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (no spec change) - [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. - [x] 3. No formatter ran; lint passes on the changed files. - [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. - [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. - [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a. - [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. - [x] 8. Title and body are in English, except the maintainer brief. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01WGufzgQpfw8pDeXcPo2zvJ
